title: Automation Tester - Banking Domain
description:
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced **Automation Tester** with strong expertise in **test automation and banking/financial services applications**. The candidate should be able to work independently in a fast\-paced environment and join **immediately or within a short notice period**.


Key Responsibilities* Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts for banking applications.
* Prepare and execute **test scenarios, test cases, regression and integration testing**.
* Automate functional, regression and end\-to\-end testing using appropriate automation frameworks.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective test cases.
* Perform **API testing** and validate backend/database data.
* Identify, document, track and validate defects through closure.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers and other QA teams.
* Participate in **SIT, UAT and production validation** activities.
* Ensure test coverage, quality standards and timely delivery.
* Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks and testing processes.


Required Skills* **10 years of experience in Software Testing / QA Automation.**
* Strong **Banking / Financial Services domain experience** is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience with **Selenium / Java / Python** or similar automation tools.
* Experience in **API testing** using tools such as Postman / REST Assured.
* Strong knowledge of **SQL and database testing**.
* Experience with **TestNG / JUnit, Maven** and automation frameworks.
* Good understanding of **Agile / Scrum methodology**.
* Experience with **JIRA, Git and CI/CD tools** will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management and test methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.


Candidate Preference* **10 years overall QA/Automation experience**
* **Banking domain experience is mandatory**
* **Immediate joiner / candidates serving short notice preferred**
* Candidates who can join immediately will be given priority.

title: Software Testing Engineer
description:
**Software Tester**

**Experience**: 2–5\+ years

**Employment Type**: Full\-time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Software Tester / QA Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications through comprehensive testing and defect management.

The candidate should have strong experience in manual testing, with exposure to automation testing, API testing, database testing, and Agile methodologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze business and technical requirements and prepare detailed test scenarios and test cases.

Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.

Identify, document, track, and verify software defects using defect\-tracking tools.

Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, and other QA team members.

Execute test cases and maintain accurate test execution and defect reports.

Participate in requirement reviews and provide feedback from a testing and quality perspective.

Perform API testing using tools such as Postman or similar platforms.

Perform basic database testing and SQL queries to validate backend data.

Contribute to automation testing using tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar technologies, where applicable.

Analyze test failures and work with development teams to identify root causes.

Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Ensure testing activities are completed within project timelines and quality standards.

Continuously improve testing processes, documentation, and overall product quality.

**Required Skills**

2–5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software testing/QA.

Strong knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and defect life cycle.

Good understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Strong experience in writing and executing test cases.

Good knowledge of functional and regression testing.

Experience with defect management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.

Good understanding of SQL and database validation.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Good communication and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Pay: ₹339,924\.92 \- ₹1,554,651\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
